inherited_actual25.meaning: Byte-identical F01 run and F02 guard/snapshot functions and focused harness preserve structural applicability under their explicit doubles. New globals/paths/dependency set and real authentication/bootstrap code need fresh review and actual capture; no automatic source-version execution credit.

isolated_cases.condition: All authenticated historical selection, closed genuine preflight binding, current bytes/state and actual descriptor agree.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: No field removed; use fixed historical row and explicit test-observer doubles only for an isolated control. Genuine applicability still requires real capture.

isolated_cases.expected_first_outcome: ValueError: bootstrap selection provenance absent from closure
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: No provenance read or current executable observation should occur.

isolated_cases.condition: Keep path regular/canonical and alter only retained provenance bytes against its declared FilePin.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Only a private control copy may be altered; never modify the sealed RI139 declaration. Earlier path/type failures receive no credit.

isolated_cases.condition: Authentically pin a private provenance-control copy with its selected binding changed while dependencies selected binding stays the original.
isolated_cases.expected_first_outcome: ValueError: accepted direct bootstrap selection provenance
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Explicit fabricated provenance only; valid read/pin/canonical framing first. No actual authority transferred to this copy.

isolated_cases.condition: Remove exactly one key from an otherwise correct preflight selected_interpreter_binding.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Historical provenance authentication must succeed first; no current executable observation.

isolated_cases.condition: Add exactly one extra key to the otherwise correct selected_interpreter_binding.
Change one selected-binding value while retaining all six keys: named alias, resolved route, link list, bytes, SHA, or one state integer.
isolated_cases.expected_first_outcome: ValueError: genuine preflight selected interpreter identity
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Each single mutation is isolated. The fixed historical binding remains untouched; source/binding hash failures at earlier gates do not count as this comparison.

isolated_cases.condition: Supply byte observation mismatch with correct provenance and preflight.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Only an explicitly substituted observer may simulate this; do not alter vendor files. Reached byte observation must be recorded.

isolated_cases.condition: Supply matching byte observation then one differing lstat state component.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Explicit lstat double; all preceding gates succeeded. A changed declared preflight state would fail B07 earlier and cannot count.

isolated_cases.condition: Supply matching provenance, preflight, bytes and state; change only observed sys.executable descriptor.
isolated_cases.reachability_and_boundary: Explicit descriptor double with every earlier observation counted. No actual interpreter substitution or scientific entry.

mandatory_real_capture_evidence: Fresh root-authenticated direct supplier/framework/host/environment preflight and exact new source admission; historical preflight is not fresh evidence.
One actual capture parent through the selected direct interpreter and both actual PRE/POST children through the same literal command entry.
Genuine parent and child complete ten-field environment checks; no CPATH/LIBRARY_PATH/MANPATH/SDKROOT relaxation, stripping or inherited extra keys.
Real sampled monitor records under180s/512MiB/25ms/100ms/50ms for both snapshots; complete real command and attempt/completion reconciliation.
Complete candidate3.11 historical guard before runtime walk, current source/runtime/selection/native/absence/dyld/host snapshots and strict full PRE/POST equality.
Complete failed or successful owned tails, source/admission custody, namespace and final exclusions; full external bootstrap POST and genuine terminal acceptance by a nonauthor/root.
required_saved_isolated_evidence: Exact new source pins and root control authority, genuine command/tool completion and original bounded monitor evidence.
Complete fabricated operands, complete expected/observed first error or returned binding, every source/metadata/current-observer call in order and substitution flags.
Prove every preceding gate succeeded and every prohibited later observer did not run; preserve primary and independent errors plus every partial, with no overwrite or retry.

Never count an earlier authentication refusal as a downstream guard test. Fixed literal-route and helper-constant checks also receive complete source review; no altered immutable provenance is silently accepted as real.
scope: These are a finite change-specific review/verification design, not an executable new harness, prescribed rerun of focused25, added preparation phase or claimed qualification. Root chooses any separately admitted isolated controls after fresh review; no generic launcher is introduced.
